title: Generate and integrate new premium BunkPro logo per provided spec

requirements.text: Create new high-resolution BunkPro logo artwork matching the user’s spec: circular emblem with a smooth purple-to-blue gradient ring; inside the circle a graduation cap combined with a bold checkmark; include a small rising bar-graph element; clean minimal futuristic look with subtle 3D depth; soft glow under the logo; dark navy background for contrast; typography in a bold modern sans-serif with “Bunk” in a purple gradient and “Pro” in a blue gradient, with slight glow and smooth shadow; ensure it remains legible and recognizable at small sizes and works well in a circular mobile icon crop.

quotes: Create a premium modern logo for a college attendance app named “BunkPro.” ... A circular emblem with a smooth purple-to-blue gradient ring ... Inside the circle: a graduation cap combined with a bold checkmark ... A small rising bar graph element ... Soft glow effect under the logo ... Dark navy background for contrast ... “Bunk” in purple gradient ... “Pro” in blue gradient ... High resolution (4K or 8K clarity) ... App icon friendly (must look good in circular mobile icon format) ... add this logo

acceptanceCriteria: New static image assets are added under frontend/public/assets/generated using the exact filenames specified in this build request’s imageRequirements.required entries.
The generated icon artwork remains clear when viewed at 48×48 and when visually cropped to a circle (no critical details cut off).
The wordmark clearly reads “BunkPro” with the requested gradient split between “Bunk” and “Pro” and a modern sans-serif look.
The background is dark navy and there is a visible soft glow under the emblem as part of the artwork in the provided exports.

requirements.text: Integrate the newly generated BunkPro logo assets into the app so all existing logo placements use the new artwork: update frontend/src/lib/branding.ts to return the new generated asset paths for both getAppIcon and getHorizontalLogo (use the same images for both dark and light themes unless separate variants are explicitly provided). Ensure the Initial Loading Splash and Settings → About automatically reflect the updated branding without changing their components’ logic.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/lib/branding.ts references the new generated logo filenames for getAppIcon(...) and getHorizontalLogo(...).
Initial loading splash screen displays the new logo without layout regressions (image loads, remains contained, and animations still run).
Settings → About displays the new horizontal/wordmark logo without breaking existing About content (app name, version text, and founder line remain).

requirements.text: Update the browser favicon to match the newly generated BunkPro logo by pointing frontend/index.html’s favicon link to the new generated favicon asset under frontend/public/assets/generated.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html references the new favicon filename specified in imageRequirements.required.
After a hard refresh, the browser tab icon uses the new favicon (no reference to the previous bunkpro-uploaded-favicon.dim_32x32.png).

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn UI components are immutable).
Do not edit any immutable frontend paths listed by the platform (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor; no backend changes are required for this request.
Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not change core attendance logic, persistence, backup/restore behavior, or notification logic as part of this branding update.
nonGoals: Redesigning or refactoring Home/Timetable/Subject Details/Settings layouts beyond what is required to display the new logo assets.
Changing the app name or tagline text displayed in the UI.
Implementing new authentication, payment, or external integrations.

required: BunkPro app icon artwork (square, dark navy background, circular gradient ring emblem with cap+check+bar graph, soft glow) (bunkpro-logo-icon.dim_4096x4096.png)
BunkPro horizontal logo/wordmark on dark navy background, with emblem + “Bunk” purple gradient and “Pro” blue gradient, subtle glow/shadow (bunkpro-logo-horizontal.dim_4096x1536.png)
Favicon derived from the new logo icon (bunkpro-favicon.dim_32x32.png)
